selected_records.title: A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories

article.body:
**Route-reproduction paper has no specified production capacity**

An arXiv paper titled “A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories” concerns route reproduction using vehicle trajectories. The available information identifies no factory or infrastructure system, installed process, production capacity or operational deployment. It also specifies no physical constraint or supply-chain recipient, so there is no documented production change to assess.
